posts.title: Protests in Europe - a Conspiracy
posts.description: Here's what I think is going on in Europe as a European. It is a bit conspiracy coded but simultaneously, I think it actually makes a lot of sense. The financial elite are richer and more powerful than ever before and REFUSE to contribute a fair share of their wealth to society through taxes.
